title: Institutional Lifecycle Summary & Status Transition Analytics

steps.title: Registrar Portal Authentication
steps.description: College Administrator / Registrar authenticates to CampXSync with authorized R31 staff session

steps.title: Navigate to Lifecycle Review Desk
steps.description: Verify College Lifecycle Review workspace loads with institutional management authority

steps.title: Inspect Lifecycle Summary & Analytics Card
steps.description: System displays live aggregate analytics card queried via GET /api/v1/lifecycle/reports/summary

steps.title: Verify Total Enrolled Students Metric
steps.description: Registrar reviews real-time total student count across all lifecycle states in tenant

steps.title: Verify Pending Petitions Bottleneck Volume
steps.description: Registrar audits current pending leave, transfer, and reinstatement requests in review queue

steps.title: Verify Active Standing Student Volume
steps.description: System renders active student count currently enrolled and in good academic standing

steps.title: Verify On Leave Student Volume
steps.description: System renders count of students on approved formal leave of absence

steps.title: Verify Graduated Conferred Student Metric
steps.description: System renders aggregate count of alumni who completed degree clearance

steps.title: Verify Transferred Standing Metric
steps.description: System renders count of students migrated to new academic programmes or branches

steps.title: Verify Withdrawn Student Metric
steps.description: System renders count of students who underwent voluntary institutional exit

steps.title: PostgreSQL Lifecycle Status Aggregate Check
steps.description: Read-only query verifies stu.lifecycle_status contains multi-record standing data for the tenant
steps.query: SELECT count(*) AS total_students FROM stu.lifecycle_status WHERE tenant_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'

steps.title: PostgreSQL Pending Requests Queue Check
steps.description: Read-only query verifies stu.lifecycle_requests contains active pending petition records
steps.query: SELECT count(*) AS pending_count FROM stu.lifecycle_requests WHERE tenant_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' AND status = 'PENDING'

steps.title: Negative RBAC Check — Gateway Direct Access Unauthenticated Denied
steps.description: Gateway strictly blocks unauthenticated requests to /api/v1/lifecycle/reports/summary with HTTP 401 Unauthorized

steps.title: Regression Check — Student Desk Role Isolation
steps.description: Authenticate as Student (R25) to verify student workspace remains strictly role-isolated

steps.title: Regression Check — Student Standing Badge Responsive
steps.description: Verify student lifecycle workspace loads without administrative analytics leakage
